metadata.name: CATALOG — Standards and obligation
metadata.uso: Selection reference. Do not load the whole catalog for a local correction.

niveles.nivel: An internal VEXARQ condition. Example: do not invent a test result.
Activated by the stack, the risk, the kind of system, or the user's request.
It may be adapted or set aside with a written justification.

entrada.validacion: The report distinguishes executed, not executed, and assumption.

entrada.nombre: Secrets stay out of the repository
entrada.validacion: No credentials in code, docs, fixtures, or commits.
The SRS separates requirement, source, and verification criterion when the profile is standard or higher.
Name the characteristics the product actually needs.
The SAD covers the index in formats/sad/SAD.md. A CRUD does not inherit the package of a distributed system.
If the project uses Scrum, roles, events, and artifacts follow the guide. A definition of ready is a team policy, not an official Scrum artifact.
Name them as techniques. Do not present them as ISO standards.
Applies to a web UI. Another level only when the user sets it.

entrada.nombre: OWASP Top 10:2025, ASVS 5.0.0, and NIST SP 800-218
entrada.validacion: ASVS becomes verifiable requirements when there is authentication, personal data, or a critical profile.
HTTP APIs in scope have a contract when the profile is standard or higher.

entrada.nombre: Conventional Commits, SemVer, Keep a Changelog
entrada.validacion: Apply them when there is a change history. A bulleted body is a VEXARQ policy, not a requirement of the specification.
Context and containers at the standard profile. Components and code only when they add something.
Apply them to deployed services or to a supply chain the user wants to harden.

autoridad.regla: A prioritization technique does not have the same authority as a standard cited by its identifier and year.
If the repository already fixed a convention, that convention prevails over an orientative recommendation.
